article_title: Should promotion depend on how workers use AI?

tasks.prompt: What central workplace dilemma does the article examine?
options: Whether AI tools should be banned from all professional work
Whether rewarding visible AI use improves performance or creates unfair incentives and insecurity
Whether workers should choose their own retirement age
Whether companies should replace performance reviews with job interviews
tasks.correct_answer: Whether rewarding visible AI use improves performance or creates unfair incentives and insecurity
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת האם קידום ותגמול לפי שימוש ב־AI באמת משפרים עבודה, או יוצרים מדדים מלאכותיים, חוסר הוגנות וחשש תעסוקתי.

tasks.prompt: Why does Duncan Trevithick question the value of his firm's AI bonus scheme?
options: He is forbidden to use AI for marketing tasks
The bonus is paid only as two extra days off each week
Higher output can become the new baseline while also proving that less of his job requires him
His employer has already cancelled every AI project
tasks.correct_answer: Higher output can become the new baseline while also proving that less of his job requires him
tasks.explanation_hebrew: טרוויתיק חושש שהתפוקה המוגברת תהפוך לנורמה בלי תגמול מקביל, ובו בזמן תמחיש שחלק מעבודתו ניתן להחלפה.

tasks.prompt: What does “disincentive” mean in Tina Chander's discussion of productivity?
options: A factor that discourages someone from taking an action
A formal guarantee of promotion
A measurement of AI accuracy
A payment made after redundancy
tasks.correct_answer: A factor that discourages someone from taking an action
tasks.explanation_hebrew: disincentive הוא גורם שמקטין את הרצון לפעול; כאן החשש הוא שיעילות ב־AI עלולה לאיים על המשרה ולכן להרתיע עובדים.

tasks.prompt: Why can an AI-usage leaderboard produce misleading evidence of productivity?
options: Employees may create unnecessary AI interactions merely to improve their ranking
AI systems cannot record how often they are used
Only senior executives are allowed to see the leaderboard
Every AI interaction necessarily improves judgement
tasks.correct_answer: Employees may create unnecessary AI interactions merely to improve their ranking
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כאשר מודדים את מספר השימושים, עובדים עלולים להעביר משימות מיותרות דרך AI כדי להיראות פעילים, בלי לשפר החלטות או תוצאות.

tasks.prompt: What approach did Duolingo adopt after reconsidering AI use in performance reviews?
options: It required AI for every task regardless of usefulness
It fired staff who did not finish AI training
It replaced performance reviews with an AI leaderboard
It prioritised doing the job well and stopped forcing AI when it did not help
tasks.correct_answer: It prioritised doing the job well and stopped forcing AI when it did not help
tasks.explanation_hebrew: דואולינגו חזרה בה והחליטה שהמדד החשוב הוא איכות ביצוע העבודה; AI רצוי כשהוא מסייע, אך אינו חובה לשם השימוש עצמו.

tasks.prompt: In Pamela's account, what does a “two tier workforce” describe?
options: Two companies sharing the same AI platform
Workers with the same role being valued differently according to AI fluency
Employees working either two or three days a week
A legal distinction between managers and contractors
tasks.correct_answer: Workers with the same role being valued differently according to AI fluency
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מתאר עובדים בעלי אותו תפקיד וותק שמקבלים ערך והזדמנויות שונים לפי מידת השליטה והנראות שלהם בשימוש ב־AI.

tasks.prompt: Compare the formal and informal ways companies in the article encourage or enforce AI use.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להביא דוגמאות למדיניות מפורשת, מדידה רשמית ולחץ שקט דרך הערכות ביצועים.
expected_points: Trevithick's firm links faster AI-enabled output to an annual bonus
Accenture's CEO said AI use is part of how the company works and affects promotion
Disney, Meta, JP Morgan and KPMG reportedly introduced AI leaderboards
Coinbase fired engineers who did not complete requested AI training
Pamela's consultancy has no formal mandate
Nevertheless AI fluency visibly affects rewards and promotion
Workers may feel pressure because vacancies are at a five-year low

tasks.prompt: Explain how making AI use a KPI can change employee behaviour without necessarily improving work.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את ההבדל בין מדידת אימוץ לבין מדידת שיקול דעת, למידה ואיכות החלטות, ולתאר התנהגות משחקית אפשרית.
expected_points: Employees optimise behaviour for the measured metric
They may log many interactions simply to hit a target
Work may be routed through a chatbot even when AI is unnecessary
Outputs can be made to look AI-related for a dashboard
The organisation measures adoption rather than judgement
High usage does not prove better learning or decisions
Employees may become compliant with the metric rather than more skilled
Amazon reportedly closed a leaderboard after employees gave AI needless tasks

tasks.prompt: Summarise the arguments for and against linking AI proficiency to promotion, bonuses or dismissal.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג באופן מאוזן את מטרות המעסיקים, יתרונות אפשריים, חששות העובדים, שאלות הוגנות והצורך במדיניות ברורה.
expected_points: Employers want returns from large AI investments
AI skills can raise output and may help workers gain bonuses or promotion
Most companies cited by McKinsey had not yet seen significant AI value
Workers may feel compelled to adapt in a weak job market
Efficiency gains can become a new baseline without proportional reward
Employees may help demonstrate that parts of their jobs are redundant
AI fluency may outweigh experience and create a two-tier workforce
Vague expectations can cause disputes about fairness and job security
Usage metrics can encourage performative rather than useful adoption
Clear policies, training and boundaries can reduce these risks

tasks.prompt: Draft a fair company policy for considering AI skills in performance reviews.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב באנגלית מדיניות שקופה המודדת תוצאות ושיקול דעת, מספקת הכשרה ומונעת שימוש כפוי או ענישה לא עקבית.
expected_points: Explain the business purpose of AI use
Define which tasks may or may not use AI
Provide equal access to training and approved tools
Assess work quality, judgement and outcomes rather than raw usage counts
Do not require AI use when it adds no value
Make promotion and bonus criteria transparent
Clarify responsibility when AI produces an error
Protect employees who raise security, legal or ethical concerns
Review workload and pay when productivity expectations rise
Offer an appeal or dispute process
Review the policy regularly as tools and roles change
